before: Changing the fonts prop on the React and Vue editors replaced the editor instance and its session.
after: Changing the fonts prop replaces local font resources through setFonts in the same session, and a replacement keeps the current faces until the new ones install.
reason: Only local font resources, measurement caches, and painted geometry change. Nothing enters shared state, operations, node identities, snapshots, or awareness payloads.

supersedesTests.reason: Reading documents ahead of their open was removed before release: measured opens of large documents were no faster and used more memory.
